# pcd_networking_network (Resource)

Manages a Neutron network in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name           = "tf-example-network"
  description    = "Managed by Terraform"
  admin_state_up = true
  shared         = false
  external       = false
  tags           = ["tf-example", "networking"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) The administrative state of the network.
- `description` (String) A description of the network.
- `external` (Boolean) Whether the network has an external routing facility.
- `name` (String) The name of the network.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the network is shared across projects.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the network.
- `tenant_id` (String) The owning project. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The network ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_network.example <id>
```
